title: Kenzi Boats

services.name: Fishing Charters
services.desc: Prior to moving to Florida, I was a driftboat captain who chased salmon, steelhead, brown trout and walleye using techniques of fly fishing, centerpinning, bottom bouncing, back trolling and side drifting. My obsession with the sport was so apparent that I was invited to host a fishing show on ESPN radio in New York. It was a wildly popular show that ran for 5 seasons on Saturday mornings until we decided to make the move to Florida. Now I am excited to take you on an exciting adventure where we target snook, trout, red fish, snapper, mahi, cobia and many others depending on the season.
